scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, PROGRESS TEST 4 - Units 7-8 (85-bet, PDF 80). Sarlavha 'PROGRESS TEST 4 | Units 7-8'. Ramka: NAME / DATE / CLASS / MARK, '(Time: 20 minutes)'. Chap chetda qaychi belgisi.

'Choose the correct item.'
1 Mary's parents have ... to the opera. A went B gone C go. 2 A: Has Ruby taken out the rubbish ...? B: No, she hasn't. A yet B since C just. 3 Penny ... already put up the tent when Jim started the fire. A has B had C have. 4 A: What did you do last night? B: We ... the children to the funfair. A taken B take C took. 5 The baby ... been sleeping all afternoon. A was B have C has. 6 We have never ... to Berlin. Have you? A gone B went C been. 7 She's ... tidied her room but she hasn't watered the plants. A since B already C yet. 8 Have you been ... here long? A working B work C worked. 9 Kate wasn't at the library. She ... gone home. A has B had C have. 10 They haven't travelled abroad ... 1980. A just B for C since. 11 I had never ... Chinese food before I went to China. A ate B eat C eaten.
12 A: How long have they been fishing? B: ... more than four hours. A Since B For C Already. 13 Jim hadn't finished cooking by the time I ... home. A was getting B got C get. 14 I have ... this dress myself. Do you like it? A make B made C making. 15 A: Why are your clothes so dirty? B: I have been ... the car. A fixed B fixing C fix. 16 When the children came home from school their mother ... baking biscuits. A is B was C were. 17 I have been a dancer ... 1992. A for B already C since. 18 A: Has John ever ... mumps? B: Yes, he has. A have B has C had. 19 A: When ... Matt buy his new car? B: Two months ago. A do B did C done. 20 By the time she was 23 years old she had ... from university. A graduated B graduate C graduates.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '85'.

exercises.explanationUz:
7-8-UNITLAR TESTI - 20 savol.

  PRESENT PERFECT: 1 have GONE
    (hali qaytmagan), 6 never BEEN
    (borib kelgan), 14 have MADE,
    18 Has John ever HAD
  YET / ALREADY / SINCE / FOR: 2
    ... YET? (savol), 7 She's
    ALREADY tidied, 10 SINCE 1980,
    12 FOR more than four hours,
    17 SINCE 1992
  PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS: 5
    HAS been sleeping, 8 Have you
    been WORKING, 15 have been
    FIXING
  PAST PERFECT: 3 HAD already put
    up ... when, 9 She HAD gone
    (wasn't - o'tgan), 11 had never
    EATEN, 13 by the time I GOT,
    20 had GRADUATED
  PAST SIMPLE: 4 We TOOK (last
    night), 19 When DID Matt buy?
  PAST CONTINUOUS: 16 mother WAS
    baking

  ⚠ GONE = ketgan (hali u yerda);
  BEEN = borib kelgan.


⚠ 'MUMPS':

  = tepki (kasallik).

items.textEn: Mary's parents have ___ to the opera.
A: Has Ruby taken out the rubbish ___? B: No, she hasn't.
Penny ___ already put up the tent when Jim started the fire.
A: What did you do last night? B: We ___ the children to the funfair.
The baby ___ been sleeping all afternoon.
We have never ___ to Berlin. Have you?
She's ___ tidied her room but she hasn't watered the plants.
Have you been ___ here long?
Kate wasn't at the library. She ___ gone home.
They haven't travelled abroad ___ 1980.
I had never ___ Chinese food before I went to China.
A: How long have they been fishing? B: ___ more than four hours.
Jim hadn't finished cooking by the time I ___ home.
items.whyUz: ⚠ by the time I got home.

items.textEn: I have ___ this dress myself. Do you like it?
A: Why are your clothes so dirty? B: I have been ___ the car.
When the children came home from school their mother ___ baking biscuits.
I have been a dancer ___ 1992.
A: Has John ever ___ mumps? B: Yes, he has.
A: When ___ Matt buy his new car? B: Two months ago.
By the time she was 23 years old she had ___ from university.

patterns.formula: EGA + have/has + gone / been + to + JOY
patterns.exampleEn: Mary's parents have gone to the opera. We have never been to Berlin.
patterns.exampleUz: Merining ota-onasi operaga ketishgan. Biz hech qachon Berlinda bo'lmaganmiz.

patterns.formula: EGA + had + V3 + by the time / when / before + O'TGAN
patterns.exampleEn: Penny had already put up the tent when Jim started the fire. I had never eaten Chinese food before I went to China.
patterns.exampleUz: Jim olov yoqqanida Penni chodirni tikib bo'lgan edi. Xitoyga borishdan oldin hech qachon xitoy taomini yemagan edim.

patterns.exampleEn: They have been fishing for more than four hours. I have been a dancer since 1992.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular to'rt soatdan ko'proq baliq ovlashyapti. Men 1992-yildan beri raqqosman.

groups.explanationUz: Betdagi go, take, eat, make, have.
